en: Pay attention, soldier! You need to take this beacon to the Snowfall graveyard and plant it! Protect it long enough so that my gryphon can lock on.$B$BIf my gryphon gets a solid strike location, Mulv and his crew will be humiliated!
I bet my friend Gruk would like this rock for the spear he is making! It's very sharp... I hope he likes it.
Very well. Warriors of the frozen wastes, rise up! I command you to fight, kill and die for your master! Let none survive!

<Valennia winces in pain as she shifts to look at you.>

Don't look at me like that. I'll be fine. Despite the best efforts of the High Elder's fretful healers, I'll be up and ready to fight again in no time.

Now be gone with you... don't let this old soldier hold you up. The winds will bring you good fortune on your journey, I know it.

Before his banishment, Deathwing was attempting to create impure offspring. Half breeds that would not only be immune to the innate natural powers and abilities of their Aspects but also under the complete control of Deathwing.$B$BIt seems that where his father failed, Nefarian may have succeeded - at least partially.$B$BIt was Ysera, Aspect of Dreams, who saw the abominations and forced us to act. If these 'Chromatic' dragonkin exist, they must be destroyed.
We have half of our needed silithyst.  We can do it!
These orders must get to High General Abbendis!
It is said that Kel'Thuzad seeks the legendary Atiesh, greatstaff of the Guardian.$B$BYes, the very staff once held by Medivh.
I heard that there are these huge fish that can walk on land to hunt, and eat people!
You will listen to this, vile duke!  I am not your Twilight's Hammer lapdog!  I am here to challenge you!  Come!  Come, and meet your death...
%s calls for help!

I have little time to sit and have idle banter with you. If you desire one of my steeds, seek Velma over there and she will teach you how to ride a skeletal steed.

I would not have you harming one of my beautiful horses with your ignorance.
At last, the serum is complete, $n. Now, come closer. We must talk.
I will hurry back to Vahlarriel. Finish off those that you can--I should be fine on my own from here.
At this rate I could have gathered them myself!
Can you tell me how I can get a Videre Elixir?
$962w Stormpike Commander(s) and $950w Stormpike Lieutenant(s).

I give you warm greetin's, $c, as does the Shattered Hand.$B$BDo not look so surprised, $n. There be shadows even on the highest perches of Orgrimmar--somethin' must hide there. The Shattered Hand take that role willingly. Thrall, even in his good heart, acknowledge that the Hand be necessary to ensure orc and troll safety.$B$BBut you not here to talk 'bout my business, you here for somethin' else.
We're on orders from on high to destroy Rajaxx. Terminate with extreme prejudice if you want to get technical.

Imagination is the limit my friend, if you can figure out how to smith it then you can make it, box it, and ship it to retailers all over the world. Of course, then you have to deal with marketing. Tell you what, let's just stick with the smithing part for now, ok?

I am unable to process your chronological reference in comparison to the recording of this data, my apologies.$B$BThough the dwarf maintains most of the Earthen's mental attunement to Azeroth's stone composition, the reversion back into living biomass remains the main degeneration of the matrix.  Dwarves eat and procreate through means typical to other standard biomasses.$B$BThe Creators view the dwarf as an acceptable variant, worthy of genesis in its own right.

<Thrall laughs.>$B$BNoted... Now pay attention, $n. The Black Dragonflight brood mother, Onyxia, has been flushed out from her position of power in Stormwind. She has escaped, fleeing to her lair in Dustwallow Marsh.$B$BShe cannot be allowed to live in such close proximity to our capital cities. We must strike before being struck!$B$BI want her destroyed, $n.
Oh no!  It's out of control!  Run!
You're looking a bit lost.  Can I help you find something?
The battle is won. For the time being, the Scourge threat has been pushed back. Our resources can be channeled into aiding you, in thanks and preparation for the future.
Do you need assistance?
I've been expecting you $n.  Are you ready to assist us in Arathi Basin?
Greetings, $n.  We've travelled from Moonglade to spread the spirit of the Lunar Festival far and wide.$B$BWon't you join us in our celebration?
Thank you, Stable Master. Please take the animal.
Have I forgotten? Of course I have... I have forgotten about love, happiness... of life itself.
There will be no escape!
Hello there $g mister : ma'am;... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?
Please, tell me more.
Where is the Frostwolf Quartermaster?
Hello, good $gsir:lady;.  Have a seat, and a meal if you're hungry.  Don't fret if I look busy with my needlework - I'm listening to you...

Are ye really askin' me where the Blacksmith is?  Have ye not heard of The Great Forge!?  All our best blacksmiths gather there to craft their weapons and armor!  

It's dead smack in the middle of Ironforge, and that's where you'll find one of our most brilliant blacksmiths, Bengus Deepforge.
%s prepares his syringe.
What you be wanting? *hic*
Finally they show mercy!  They've given us something to drink!
There you have it. Our lesson on summoning has come to an end. A new class will begin shortly, so if you wish to brush up, feel free to stay around.
I be seeking someone, $c. Please, leave me be... it is important I find them.
How can I get anything done with the Scourge running amok in here?!
I saw a Sea Giant once.  It's not something I would care to see again.  Burp!
Who dares step into my domain!  Come!  Come, and be consumed!
Ironfoe?
